warnings: *** THE MOST VALUABLE THING ON THIS SHEET IS THE VERTICAL SET-OUT, WHICH APPEARS NOWHERE ELSE IN THE SET SO FAR. *** Road +0.00, first floor +0.40, second floor +3.40, ring beam +6.65 on the two-storey block and +3.80 on the single-storey wing. The structural sheets gave levels only for the foundations (-1.00 to -1.50) and never named a storey height.

FLOOR-TO-FLOOR IS 3.00 M and the second floor to the ring beam is 3.25 m, so the upper storey is the taller of the two. The single-storey wing's ring beam sits only 0.40 m above the second-floor line, which is why the wing roof tucks under the main roof on the elevation.
Roof pitch 25° is confirmed here for a third time (A-06, A-07, A-08 all agree) and the 1.20 m eaves oversail for a third time as well.

TWO SMALL FACADE ELEMENTS ARE SPECIFIED HERE AND NOWHERE ELSE: a 100 x 100 mm rendered cornice band ('บัวปูนปั้น ฉาบปูนเรียบ ทาสี สูง 10 ซม หนา 10 ซม') and 10 x 10 mm scored grooves ('แนวเซาะร่อง กว้าง 1 ซม ลึก 1 ซม') used as horizontal banding. Both are quantifiable and both are called out twice.
The 2.10 m dimension on the left of the bottom chain is the minimum side setback A from the site plan (A-04), not part of the building.
Opening numbers are drawn on the elevation as well but at 1:100 they carry the same door/window symbol ambiguity as the plans, so they are not enumerated here -- A-22 and A-23 hold the schedules.
